vision.short_term: Short-term goal is to make the whole project as easy as possible to set up and use by developers. Onboarding and daily usage must offer as little friction as possible.
vision.mid_term: Mid-term goal is to make the project more widely available to other developers, transitioning from a private repository to a public one.
vision.long_term: Long-term goal is to continue to build a reliable agentic development toolset whose philosophy is "Personas first": Focus on the essentials before agentic tools and IDEs. All the integrated tools exist only to support the personas, and LLM-independent by design.

vision.mid_term:
Mid-term goals: 

- Improve test coverage
- Refactor more modules to use namespaces
- PHP code update
- PHPStan level increase, stricter typing
- Clean up the custom repository dependencies
